editorial.thesis: A motor-trade-and-banking city of about 440,000. Its retail is heavy on desserts, sweets & ice cream and banks & atms, and thin on fitness & wellness and pharmacy & health retail — and 20% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 59% of Ahmedabad's. 8.4 chain outlets per lakh residents against 14.34 in Ahmedabad; 17 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Pizza Hut 5, Apollo Pharmacy 4, Domino's 3.

The mapped economy leans to malls & department stores. Shares of all mapped places: malls & department stores 1.0% (Ahmedabad 0.6%); automotive 4.0% (Ahmedabad 2.7%); services & crafts 4.3% (Ahmedabad 7.2%); offices 12.9% (Ahmedabad 18.7%). Raw counts would mislead because Ahmedabad is mapped more completely (54,281 places against 2,954), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 3 zones hold 20% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Chitra alone has about 44,000 residents and 3 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Ahmedabad. 52% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Ahmedabad 46%). The largest cores are Wadva · Gogha Circle (1,107 places) and Takhteshwar (555).

The widest brand gaps against Ahmedabad. Apollo Pharmacy 4 outlets vs 83; Café Coffee Day 2 outlets vs 46; Domino's 3 outlets vs 45. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 6 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Ahmedabad, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Wadva · Gogha Circle and Takhteshwar are the largest zones by residents (192,000 and 128,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 52% of all commercial places, and Wadva · Gogha Circle alone lists 1,107.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Wadva · Gogha Circle holds 18 of the 37 tracked chain outlets, and Takhteshwar adds 15.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Wadva · Gogha Circle and Takhteshwar lead on education places (97 and 89, with 21 and 30 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Chitra and Station Road · Kumbharwada. The blue cores include Wadva · Gogha Circle.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (54,281 places in Ahmedabad against 2,954 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Ahmedabad; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Ahmedabad, Bhavnagar's mapped places over-index on malls & department stores (1.0% vs 0.6%), automotive (4.0% vs 2.7%), desserts & sweets (1.1% vs 0.8%) and under-index on services & crafts (4.3% vs 7.2%), offices (12.9% vs 18.7%), grocery & daily needs (1.1% vs 1.2%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 37 outlets of 17 tracked national brands within 6 km — 8.4 per lakh residents against Ahmedabad's 14.34 (624 outlets of 38 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Ahmedabad are Apollo Pharmacy (4 vs 83); Café Coffee Day (2 vs 46); Domino's (3 vs 45). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Ahmedabad's, so low means thin by Ahmedabad's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 6 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Bhavnagar's age mix against Ahmedabad: children (0–14) 26.8% vs 23.9%, 15–24 20.6% vs 19.3%, working age 44.3% vs 48.8%, 60+ 8.3% vs 8.0%. Under-25s are 47% of residents.

zones.364001: Reasonably supplied: 1,107 places for about 192,000 residents (index 113), 18 chain outlets.
zones.364002: Reasonably supplied: 555 places for about 128,000 residents (index 85), 15 chain outlets.
zones.364004: An under-served zone: about 44,000 residents, 115 mapped places, 3 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 52.
zones.364003: Reasonably supplied: 82 places for about 23,000 residents (index 69), 0 chain outlets.
zones.364006: An under-served zone: about 22,000 residents, 24 mapped places, 0 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 22.
zones.364005: An under-served zone: about 20,000 residents, 17 mapped places, 1 food & drink and 1 chain outlet. Depth index 17.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.3% of mapped places against 4.4% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Pizza Hut 5 (Ahmedabad 20), Domino's 3 (Ahmedabad 45), La Pino'z 2 (Ahmedabad 20), Subway 1 (Ahmedabad 34). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Biryani By Kilo, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.0% of mapped places against 1.8% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 2 (Ahmedabad 46). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 1.1% of mapped places against 0.8% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Havmor 1 (Ahmedabad 35). No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.1% of mapped places against 1.2% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 2 (Ahmedabad 28), DMart 1 (Ahmedabad 13). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Vishal Mega Mart.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.5% of mapped places against 0.6% in Ahmedabad — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 4 (Ahmedabad 83). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 5.5% of mapped places against 5.5% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Trends 3 (Ahmedabad 26), Raymond 3 (Ahmedabad 34), Bata 2 (Ahmedabad 29), Tanishq 2 (Ahmedabad 16).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 10.7% of mapped places against 8.1% in Ahmedabad — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 2.2% of mapped places against 2.3% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 2.8% of mapped places against 3.8% in Ahmedabad — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
